title: Job: Oh, That I Were as in Months Past

questions.question: Oh, that I were as in the months of old, as in the days when God did what?
questions.explanation: Job 29:2 (ESV): "Oh, that I were as in the months of old, as in the days when God watched over me,"

questions.question: When his lamp shone upon my head, and by his light I walked through what?
questions.explanation: Job 29:3 (ESV): "when his lamp shone upon my head, and by his light I walked through darkness,"

questions.question: When the friendship of God was upon my what?
questions.explanation: Job 29:4 (ESV): "as I was in my prime, when the friendship of God was upon my tent,"

questions.question: When I went out to the gate of the city, when I prepared my seat in the what?
questions.explanation: Job 29:7 (ESV): "when I went out to the gate of the city, when I prepared my seat in the square,"

questions.question: The young men saw me and withdrew, and the aged rose and did what?
questions.explanation: Job 29:8 (ESV): "the young men saw me and withdrew, and the aged rose and stood;"

questions.question: The ear that heard me called me what?
questions.explanation: Job 29:11 (ESV): "When the ear heard, it called me blessed, and when the eye saw, it approved,"

questions.question: Because I delivered the poor who cried for help, and the fatherless who had none to what?
questions.explanation: Job 29:12 (ESV): "because I delivered the poor who cried for help, and the fatherless who had none to help him."

questions.question: I caused the widow's heart to what?
questions.explanation: Job 29:13 (ESV): "The blessing of him who was about to perish came upon me, and I caused the widow's heart to sing for joy."

questions.question: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me; my justice was like a robe and a what?
questions.explanation: Job 29:14 (ESV): "I put on righteousness, and it clothed me; my justice was like a robe and a turban."

questions.question: I was eyes to the blind and feet to the what?
questions.explanation: Job 29:15 (ESV): "I was eyes to the blind and feet to the lame."

questions.question: I was a father to the needy, and I searched out the cause of whom?
options: Him whom I did not know
questions.correctAnswer: Him whom I did not know
questions.explanation: Job 29:16 (ESV): "I was a father to the needy, and I searched out the cause of him whom I did not know."

questions.question: I broke the fangs of the unrighteous and made him drop his prey from his what?
questions.explanation: Job 29:17 (ESV): "I broke the fangs of the unrighteous and made him drop his prey from his teeth."

questions.question: Then I thought, 'I shall die in my nest, and I shall multiply my days as the what?'
questions.explanation: Job 29:18 (ESV): "Then I thought, 'I shall die in my nest, and I shall multiply my days as the sand,'" (Note: some translations suggest phoenix, but ESV text says "sand" here).

questions.question: My roots spread out to the waters, with the dew all night on my what?
questions.explanation: Job 29:19 (ESV): "my roots spread out to the waters, with the dew all night on my branches,"

questions.question: I chose their way and sat as chief, and I lived like a king among his what?
questions.explanation: Job 29:25 (ESV): "I chose their way and sat as chief, and I lived like a king among his troops, like one who comforts mourners."

key_verse_text: Oh, that I were as in the months of old, as in the days when God watched over me,
